english: Karaoke was so much fun!
Yeah, there was that little accident, but\never since, Aria and the rest of us\nstopped holding back around each other, kind of.
She still says\nshe's keeping a strict eye on us, though...
Come to think of it, where's Hibiki?
She dragged Aria out with her.
Somewhere along the way, Hibiki ended up\nbeing the one dragging Aria around.
She's so full of energy!
//Background: Open plain
Osu! Pleased to spar with you!
You really want to spar without transforming?\nYou could power up, you know.
It's fine! What I want you to teach me\nis strength itself!
Strength - pretty abstract, don't you think.
The thing is... right now\nI can't use my own power properly.
What do you mean?
I've always had a tendency to lose control,\nso I trained to get stronger\nin order to control my power.
But now I can't handle my power again,\nand... I've gotten scared\nof going all out.
...Pathetic, I know.
So you want to train again?
Yes! I can't think of any other way.
Let me say this first:\nthere are three phrases I hate.\n"I can't," "I'm tired," "what a pain"...
Those three phrases hold back\nhuman potential all by themselves.\nNever say them in front of me. Got it?
I promise!
Okay - for the next 30 minutes,\nI'll keep attacking you nonstop.\nBlock or dodge.
Huh? Not 3 minutes - 30 minutes!?
And... begin.
//From flash, to black background.\n//SE: Striking sounds. Rapid smacks and thuds, finishing blows, gunshots too.
Wowww...
All I'll praise you for is not dying.\nEverything else is a zero.
Thaaanks... *pant, pant*...
Get it now?
Yes... I get it real well now.\nThat I can still get so much stronger...
...Huh.\nThat part of you, I don't hate...
That's right, Aria!\nLet's go eat! FOOD!\nYou're hungry too, riiight?
Huh!?
(I beat her senseless, she couldn't even stand...\nand she's already recovered?\nWhat even ARE you...)
Hm?
//Fade to black\n//Background: Butei High classroom
We've been in this world a while now, but\nwe're not gathering any intel.
Well, I've asked them to check whether\nthe teacher came to this world too.\nBut no leads there either.
Looks like Hibiki's training is the only thing\ngoing great.
Yes! Food tastes great every day!
//Shirayuki enters.
I have something to tell everyone.\nIs now a good time?
Hello, Shirayuki.
Did something happen?
No - from now on, I'll be in charge of\nlooking after all of you,\nso I came to say so.
What about Aria? Is she quitting?
Ms. Kanzaki is cooperating with the investigation of a major case,\nso she'll be away from Butei High for a while.
Could she be chasing the Butei Killer overseas?
No, she's been dispatched to investigate\na string of bizarre serial murders.
A string of headless corpses of young girls\nhas been found, and at the police's request\nMs. Kanzaki is being dispatched.
Wait - headless corpses!?
Let me help with that investigation too!\nThis sounds a lot like a case\nfrom my world!
Um... I appreciate the thought, but\nthat's impossible.
Why?
The police and public security are moving on this.\nYour existence is a secret, so\nthis one is...
Still, if a dream demon or Noise showed up,\nit could get bad, you know?
Even Aria\nmight be in danger!
I'm sorry... I can't change\nButei High's decision on my own.\nAll I can ask is your understanding...
I see...
//Fade to black - time passes
Hmph, they said we'd get cooperation\nfrom Butei High...
In the end they won't let us do anything.
Then let's force our way through\nand go save Aria!
//Riko appears
I heard everything!\nSo everyone just LOVES\nme, huh!!
Riko!?
Howdyy☆
Did you hear, Riko?\nAbout Aria...
Of course. It's the hottest topic\nat Butei High right now.
Anyway, I came because there's something\nI want you all to hear.
See, Aria's been\nlooking for a partner all this time.
A partner?
Yeah. Aria's family has always had\nexcellent partners, generation after generation.
But Aria never found one.\nA partner worthy of her strength -\nshe just hasn't discovered one yet.
So Aria decided.\nTo do everything alone.
Alone... just like her name.
Hm?? What does that mean?
An aria is a solo song in opera.\nA part sung alone.\nWe learned it in school.
Even if she's managed alone so far,\nthis time might be bad news, don't you think?\nThe Butei Killer isn't that easy an opponent.
W-wait,\ndo you think Riko believes the headless corpse\nmurders are connected to the Butei Killer?
The Butei Killer is super cunning.\nI doubt she'd leave Aria alone\nwhen Aria's hunting her, y'knoww?
Mixed in with the serial murders,\nfinishing off Aria... plausible.
Rem! Let's go after all!
But we can't just\nact on our own...!
Which is where I come in!\nSign a contract with Riko of the Detective Department (Inquesta),\nand I can help out with all sorts of thingss☆
Scrambling intel, disposing of evidence, cover-ups!\nCheap rates right noww?
...Doesn't look like we have a reason to refuse.
//Scene change\n//Background: Night streets\n//Aria, here to investigate
A murder investigation, huh. For my first time,\nI didn't expect to be this nervous...
No... that's not it. My gut is telling me\nthis case is bad news...!
This doesn't look good either... this is bad...\nI just hope THAT doesn't show up...
Hoh, what a fine face... show me more of it.
Who's there!? Show yourself!
//Event CG: Dr. Shinigami appears
Tonight's prey is decided...
I'm the prey?\nThen you're the Butei Killer!
The Butei? I don't kill such trifles.\nI kill only beautiful things.
So you want this neck of mine.\nToo bad - showing yourself to me\nwas your unlucky break!
Good... let me see that bold face\ntwist in terror, scream, and flee.\nIn your dreams...!
Huh!? Dreams? That makes no sense!\nPrepare yourself, you pervy cape!!
//Event CG off
Fufufu...
//SE: Gas hissing
Wh-!? G-gas...!?
Good night, mademoiselle...
Damn! My consciousness...
//SE: Aria collapsing
*inhale... exhale...*
How fragile... Now, time for my little diversion.\nLet me enjoy a lovely nightmare...
//Dr. Shinigami vanishes\n//The [CLAUDE] party rushes in
There! Aria!\nHuh? Is she... asleep?
This is "Sudden Street-Sleeping Phenomenon"!\nWe've got to wake her up!
With this alarm watch...!\nWake up! Aria!
//SE: Alarm sound
Ungh... wha-!? What? Where... where am I...?
Aria! Thank goodness!
//Dr. Shinigami appears.
Fuh fuh fuh... so you've finally come...
I knew it - this was your doing.\n...Dr. Shinigami!
Long time no see, Dream Hunter Rem.\nI crawled back from the depths of hell\njust to see your face...
Revived again!? You really never learn!
Rem, what is this!?
The culprit behind the "Sudden Street-Sleeping Phenomenon",\nthe bizarre serial murders, and my arch-nemesis... Dr. Shinigami!\nAnd I've finished him off at least three times already...!
Finished him off three times!?\nWhat does that mean!?
No need for you to understand.
Rem, I won't kill you now.\nYou understand, don't you? Even if we fought here,\nyou could never defeat me.
What a fine face. I'll wipe away that boldness\nand paint it over with terror...\nI'll enjoy this to the fullest.
That is...
Shut up, old man! Eat leaaad!!
//SE: Gunshot\n//Aria shoots Dr. Shinigami
Hmph.
No way!? The bullet just went right through him!?
So what?\nWant to try putting more holes in me?
Fuh fuh fuh fuh, haa haa haa ha!\nHee hee hee hee!! Ha HAA!!
//Dr. Shinigami vanishes.
Wh-what... he turned to liquid... and evaporated...?
...Damn!
It's him...! It's him! It's HIM!!\nHe's the Butei Killer! I'm sure of it!!
Come out! I'll catch you and drag you to court!!
Ahahaha! HIM being the Butei Killer?\nAria, you've really got a gift for comedy!
//Riko appears
Hey!
Riko...?
Aren't you ashamed before\nyour ancestors, with deduction that dumb?\nRight, Holmes?
Holmes? Who? Who is that?
Hey, please - don't go losing\nto anyone but me, okay?\nThat'd be really inconvenient...
...What do you mean?
You're a hopeless idiot.\nI came all the way here for you, so\nI'll introduce myself, since I have to.
//[Event CG] Riko declares she is Lupin
My name is Mine Riko Lupin the Fourth.
Lupin...
Yes. France's great gentleman thief\nArsene Lupin is my great-grandpappy.\nAnd my other name is...
The Butei Killer.
//Event CG off
Huh!?
Riko's the Butei Killer!?
Kufu! You could've figured it out\na little sooner, y'know?
You...? Why!!
Because Riko is Riko.
What does that mean...?
...Everyone in my family\nnever called me "Riko".
Even though Mama gave me\nsuch a cuuute name... it's "Fourth,\nFourth, Lady Fourth" all the time.
Am I a number!? Just genes!?\nI'm Riko! Not a number!
What's got you so worked up!?\nWhat's wrong with being a number!!
I hate being treated as Lupin's great-granddaughter\nforever! If I don't surpass great-grandpappy,\nI'll never be ME!
What does that have to do with the Butei Killer?
The Butei Killer? That was just a little game.\nMy real target is YOU! Holmes the Fourth!
Don't tell me you didn't know.\n100 years ago, Lupin and Holmes faced off,\nand it ended in a draw.
If I defeat Holmes the Fourth,\nit'll prove I've surpassed great-grandpappy!
...And you lot over there\nbetter do your part too.
Huh?? Our... part...?
//Battle map: City (night)
A Holmes with no partner\nisn't worth defeating... but then\nyou lot showed up.
Not to brag, but\nI've outgrown this world,\ny'know.
So Holmes's partner needs to be\nsomeone on my level, right?
Your skills are iffy, but all of you together -\nyou qualify as Holmes's partner,\ndon't you?
Don't go deciding things on your own!\nI don't need a partner!
I've already decided!\nI'll go it alo-
//SE: Violent thunder
Eep!?
Aria?\nCould it be the thunder...?
N-no, I'm not scared! Not scared\nat all...
//SE: Violent thunder
Hyaaaaah!
Aria! I'm right here with you!\nIf lightning strikes, I'll crush it\nin my bare hands!
Hibiki...!!
Aria, we may not be fit\nto be the partner of your solo...\nbut...!
...I think we could manage\nbeing your backup chorus.
That's right!!
Let's catch the Butei Killer!
You guys...
//Event CG off
...I don't know if I can call you\nmy partners, and I hate\nplaying into Riko's hands. But...!
There's something I've got to do!\nAnd for that...!!
That's the spirit, Holmes!\nAll going according to plan!\nNo complaints from anyone!
Today, Riko becomes RIIKO!
//Enemy grunt units appear\n//■ Battle start
Tch. You're not half bad...
Butei Killer, a.k.a. Mine Riko Lupin the Fourth!\nYou're under arrest!
...If you can do this much,\nthen you lot qualify\nas Holmes's partners.
That's all I needed to know for now.\nHolmes!\nIf you want to arrest me, come chase me!
Show me you and your partner's strength,\nand then be defeated by Riko!\nThen I'll...!!
//Riko, enveloped in light, vanishes.
She vanished!?
This light is...!
The same light as when we\nmoved to another world...?
//■ Battle end\n//Background: City (night)
Riko vanishing -\nwas that a coincidence, like with us...?
No. She said "come chase me."\nSo we should assume this wasn't\nsome coincidence with an unknown destination.
It stays a mystery...
Sheesh, thanks to you lot\nthis got complicated.\nThis is why I say I'm better off alone.
Aria...
Sorry. That was a lie.
Mama's always told me\nto find a partner.\nI think I finally get what she meant.
My ideal would be\none proper partner,\nbut for now... I guess you lot will do...
Aha!! Really!?
Don't get the wrong idea!\nRiko vanished, right? I need a way\nto chase her, that's all!
Right. Let's just say our interests\naligned with hers.
Th-that's right!
Thank goodness...
What's "good" about it! You're going to be\nmy slave-in-training, so work\nlike a draft horse!
S-slave-in-training...? Being a draft horse\nsounds like better treatment...!?
Shut up! It's decided!
I-I want to be treated like a human again...
Come to think of it, what IS "Holmes"?
It's my middle name.\nHolmes is the French pronunciation -\nspelled H, O, L, M, E, S.
Kanzaki Holmes Aria.\nThat's my full name.
Holmes? THE detective Holmes!?
I know him too!\nWow, so he was a real person!!
Umm...
Who's Holmes?
(They don't know, huh...)
Anyway, hurry up and tell me\nhow to chase Riko.
Huh?
Huh?
Huh?
Huh?
//Remove all characters
What? That's your specialty, isn't it?
Um, that's what we don't know, so we tried\ngetting Butei High to cooperate and...
They put us under surveillance and\nwouldn't let us do a single thing.
What!?\nSo we can't chase Riko!?
After all, we were watched by the strongest\nS-rank Butei of the Assault Department...
Shut up! Keep complaining and I'll put a hole in you!
//Light begins to envelop the party.
Ugh!? ...I've been shot...
I didn't shoot!
But I saw the muzzle flash...
No, that's not it!!
I wonder what this is - this timing\nis too good to be coincidence...
Where are we being sent?
Huh!?
//Enveloped in light, they move.\n//Background: Dokoka Town
...Wh-what happened?
This is Dokoka Town.
Phew... it doesn't look like\nwe'll be attacked out of nowhere here.
Don't be so sure. Look!\nI sense people!
Eek!? Someone's here!?
//The [NOEL] party appears
Ahh! [MERU]!
[NOEL]?
Geez, where did you go!!
You too! You never came\nto Rem's office!
Ah, look, Aoi! There are\nlots of people over there!
Indeed.\nThey seem to be [NOEL]'s\nacquaintances...
...Ah! G-good work today!\nUm, are you fellow cast members!?
Looks like [NOEL] picked up\nmore tagalongs too.
Huh? But I don't see Tsubasa?
Tsubasa!? Tsubasa's here!?
You're Tsubasa's partner?\nTsubasa is, um...
//Fade to black - time passes
Wh... Tsubasa used the Superb Song...?
It was incredible power. But if Tsubasa\nhadn't done that, I don't know\nwhat would've become of us...
Knowing Tsubasa,\nshe felt she had no choice.
What happens when you use this Superb Song thing?
It depends on Tsubasa's condition.\nAt worst, it could kill her, but...\nI want to believe Tsubasa will be fine.
...Tsubasa was like that too, but\nyou're strong as well.
No, I'm still nowhere near good enough.\nI'm still learning from Aria.
Hibiki, are these people acquaintances of yours?
We should exchange a bit more\ninformation with each other.
//Fade to black - time passes
Wow! So Hibiki transforms\nlike Tsubasa?
Yes! Did you hear Tsubasa's song?
Yeah! It was sooo cool!!
Ah, but...
Um - Tsubasa will be fine, I'm sure!\nTsubasa fights ready to stake her life,\nbut she would never treat life lightly!
I know that better than anyone -\nI've fought beside her!
Hibiki...
Only by trusting each other\nare you truly partners.
Exactly!
But it's also true that Tsubasa used that power\nso the enemy couldn't steal the "Angel's Tears"\nthat we must protect.
For that, please let me thank her.\nWe were saved thanks to Tsubasa.
Please tell her that directly!\nI'm sure we'll meet again!
You sure say that confidently\nwith zero evidence.
Because I believe in Tsubasa.
That's how much you've fought together.
Hibiki and Tsubasa are such a great pair...\nI wish we could be like that too...
Hehe, that's right, Haruka.
(A partner, huh...)
Huh? Are Haruka and Aoi\nfighting something too?\nYou two are the ones who call the Twin Angels, right?
Yes. Aoi and I don't fight directly, but\nwe've been close friends forever.
Right, Aoi!
Speaking of partners,\nwhere are [MERU] and\n[NOEL]?
Oh, those two? They went off\nthat way, all lively and chatty!
//Fade to black\n//Background: Forest
Geez! I told you not to do anything reckless!\nWe should've just gone\nto Rem's office!
Now you've dragged more people into this - even Tsubasa...
Th-that's not true! Well, what about YOU then!
I can guess well enough!
You just charged in\non the spur of the moment\nand this is what happened, [NOEL]!
Unyuuuuh, well what about YOU then!
From what I've heard,\n[MERU] hasn't\ndone a single thing!
Th-that's not true...!\nI did too...
After dragging Rem and the others into this,\nyou've just been freeloading\nyour way here, haven't you?
Hmph!!\nIf you're gonna say that, let me ask YOU!\nAre you even properly searching for the teacher!?
We've got to get back to our own world\nbefore we can even search for the teacher!
Did it ever occur to you\nthat the teacher might have gone to another world too?
Oh...
I knew it -\n[NOEL]'s an idiot!!
Then let me ask -\ndid YOU search properly?\nDid you find any leads?
W-well, no, but, but...
Do you even have proof the teacher's in another world?\nShouldn't getting back to our world come first?
That doesn't mean it's okay that you\nforgot to search for the teacher!!
...Fine.\nThen let's each search\nour own way from now on.
Huh?
I'll search for the teacher MY way!\nThat's fine, right!
There you go acting on impulse again!
So what! That's my way!\nByyyye!
//[NOEL] exits.
[NOEL]!?
I'm not\n[MERU]'s punching bag, y'know!
Honestly, you're so selfish!
//[CLAUDE] arrives
Um, shouldn't you go after her...?
It's almost mealtime, so she'll\ncome right back anyway.
//Background: Dokoka Town\n//Polial (stone) is present.
Hesitation means defeat! Here I gooo!!
//Light flares and [NOEL] vanishes.\n//Fade to black\n//Background: Dokoka Town - shop
No way! [NOEL]!?
Yup! She's gone!\nShe's not in this town anymore!
Geez! You're not sorry at all!!
...Idiot...
//Background: Dokoka Town\n//Everyone gathers to discuss what to do next.
[NOEL]\nwent off on her own?
We've got to go after her!
Go after her how? We can't even chase her anywhere.
That's the problem.\nRight now, if we leave Dokoka Town,\nwe have no idea where we'd end up.
Then perhaps it'd be better\nto wait for [NOEL] to\ncome back here.
Then I'm heading on ahead.\nSitting around waiting\nisn't going to make Riko show up here.
Isn't splitting up a bad idea?
I'm not getting stuck in place\nover someone who wandered off on her own!\nNo way!
Aria's right.\nWe don't need to worry\nabout [NOEL].
Aren't you worried, [MERU]?
I'd be lying if I said I wasn't worried.\nBut if I keep spoiling her,\nshe'll never grow.
So that's your kind of trust -\nthat [MERU] will\nbe fine alone.
She's a kid at heart,\nbut [NOEL]'s techniques\nare strong.
Th-this is a new development!\nWhen those two meet again,\nwhat on earth will happen...!
You're weirdly carefree, huh?
(Aria, Sonico is a rookie idol\nwho thinks all of this\nis a movie shoot...)
(Thinks it's a shoot, huh...\nWell, she'd probably be happier\ngoing back to her world none the wiser...)
So for now, we all act as one -\ndoes that sound alright, I wonder?
Yeeess.
(Riko, I'll catch you for sure...!\nWait for me, Mama...)
//END
